name: CTSpine1K
what: 1,005 CT volumes with vertebra masks, gathered from four public sources (MIRACLE-Center; doi:10.59275/j.melba.2025-gf84)

segmentations.masks: vertebra masks from C1 to L6 and the sacrum, each vertebra named by level in VerSe's convention (a T13 is label 28), as rawdata/labels/<source>/*_seg.nii.gz

how_to_get: Held: on the grid at /rs/rs_grp_oschome/go2432/data/ctspine1k, downloaded from the Hugging Face copy with each file's sha256, 2026-09-23; nothing to fetch.
To share it with collaborators, copy it into /rs/rs_grp_oschome/shared/datasets/ctspine1k/ with its checksums as a Slurm job, as the pig set of #22 was copied, and note the job in the history.
record: SchwingNet data/sources/ctspine1k_ctpelvic1k_ribfrac.json, split into its three sets, 2026-10-23
source_status: held on the grid under the owner's data root, as SchwingNet's registry records it on 2026-10-23

history.note: on the grid at /rs/rs_grp_oschome/go2432/data/ctspine1k, downloaded from the Hugging Face copy with each file's sha256, 2026-09-23, before the shared tree and its promoter existed; the record written for the census (#178) from SchwingNet's registry
